descriptionChirho: The gentilic adjective Netophati/Netophatite, designating a person from the town of Netophah near Bethlehem. All four clusters refer to the same gentilic with only grammatical variation: with article 'the Netophathite' (S117565, 8x), bare form (S117567), with conjunction waw 'and Netophathite' (S117568), and another bare occurrence (S117569). Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm: eng 'the Netophatite/Netofati', spa 'el netofatita/Netofa', hin 'Natopati' (नतोपाती), arb 'an-Natufati' (النَّطُوفَاتِيُّ), kor 'Nedoba saram' (네토바 사람/느도바인), swa 'Mnetofathi/Wanetofa'. These are inflectional variants of a single gentilic designation.
